description: pkix_revocation::Error::Revoked has reason_code: Option<u8>. RFC 5280 §5.3.1 defines CRL reason codes as an enumeration. x509_cert::ext::pkix::crl::CrlReason is already imported and used in crl.rs and ocsp.rs to decode the reason. Exposing it as u8 loses type safety: callers must know that 1 = keyCompromise, 2 = caCompromise, etc. Using Option<CrlReason> would make callers' match arms self-documenting and catch invalid reason codes at the type boundary. The cast 'reason as u8' in two places is the tell.
title: Error::Revoked reason_code: Option<u8> should be Option<CrlReason>
